testCases.title: Billing page loads successfully with authentication
preconditions: User is logged in at /auth with valid email and password
steps: Navigate to /billing
Verify page loads without redirect to login
Confirm billing header and main content area are visible
testCases.expectedResult: Billing page loads successfully, displaying the bill generation interface with navigation elements, no authentication errors, and user role-appropriate controls visible

testCases.title: Billing history table displays existing bills with correct data
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
Multiple bills exist in the system for different lodgers
steps: Navigate to /billing
Scroll to billing history section
Verify table displays columns for bill ID, lodger name, amount, status, and date
Check that auto-generated bills appear with correct amounts
Verify bill statuses (paid, pending, overdue) are color-coded
testCases.expectedResult: Billing history table renders with all existing bills, each showing accurate lodger information, correct amounts, proper status indicators, and chronological ordering from newest to oldest

testCases.title: Bill status filter and navigation between sections works correctly
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
steps: Navigate to /billing
Click on 'Paid' filter tab
Verify only paid bills are displayed
Click on 'Pending' filter tab
Verify only pending bills are displayed
Click on 'Overdue' filter tab
Verify only overdue bills are displayed
Click 'View All' to reset filters
testCases.expectedResult: Filter tabs correctly display bills matching the selected status, switching between filters updates the table without page reload, and 'View All' restores the complete bill list

testCases.title: Bill generation creates new bill with correct lodger details
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
At least one active lodger exists in the system
steps: Navigate to /billing
Click 'Generate New Bill' button
Select an active lodger from dropdown
Verify lodger details (name, room number) populate automatically
Review calculated amount based on stay duration and rates
Click 'Confirm and Save'
testCases.expectedResult: New bill is generated successfully with correct lodger details, accurate amount calculation, and appears in billing history with 'Pending' status

testCases.title: Empty state displays when no bills exist in the system
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
No bills exist in the system (admin cleared all records)
steps: Navigate to /billing
Observe the billing history section
Check for empty state message or illustration
Verify 'Generate New Bill' button is still accessible
testCases.expectedResult: Empty state displays a clear message such as 'No bills found' with an appropriate illustration, and the generate bill button remains enabled for creating new bills

testCases.title: Auto-generated monthly bill for lodger with extended stay handles edge case of overlapping billing periods
preconditions: User is logged in as Employee
Lodger has stay spanning across two billing cycles (e.g., 15th of previous month to 15th of current month)
steps: Navigate to /billing
Locate the auto-generated bill for the overlapping period
Verify the bill correctly prorates charges across the two billing periods
Check that no duplicate charges appear for the overlapping days
Confirm the total amount matches the expected prorated calculation
testCases.expectedResult: Auto-generated bill correctly handles overlapping billing periods with accurate prorated charges, no duplicate entries, and the total amount reflects the correct calculation for the extended stay
